scheme_name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt Students
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) category
Parents' annual income must be between ₹1,00,000 and ₹4,50,000
Student must not be covered under the Government of India Scholarship
Student may have at most one failure
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of tuition, admission, term, library, laboratory, gymkhana, and examination fees for VJNT students at post‑matriculation institutions.
